posts.name: Synczipr
posts.tagline: Unzip large archives without filling up your disc.
posts.description: Synczipr solves the infamous "Disk Full" error when unpacking massive files. Traditional extractors require enough disk capacity for both the original archive AND the extracted files simultaneously. Synczipr eliminates this storage overhead at the byte level. How it works: Using a stream-based extraction engine, it decompresses files sequentially. Synczipr immediately eliminates the consumed portion of the original archive by employing sparse-file hole punching as each chunk is extracted.
